description.value: An fMRI study of neural correlates of direct self-evaluations, direct evaluations of a best friend, reflected self-evaluations from a best friend's perspective, and malleability evaluations across academic, physical, and social domains in early adolescents and young adults.

spans.text: The current fMRI study investigates the neural foundations of evaluating oneself and others during early adolescence and young adulthood.

description.value: Cross-sectional comparison of early adolescents and young adults with repeated-measures evaluative perspective and trait-domain factors; participants completed a single scanning session.

spans.text: To investigate developmental differences in neural recruitment during self-processing, in particular interaction effects between age group, evaluative perspective, and domain, a 2 (age group: adults/adolescents) × 4 (evaluative perspective: direct self/direct other/reflected self/malleability) × 3 (domain: academic/physical/social) whole-brain, repeated-measures ANOVA was conducted, with age group as the between-subjects factor and evaluative perspective and domain as the within-subjects factors.

model_settings.value: Trial durations were modeled using participant reaction times; 128-second high-pass filter; AR(1) temporal autocorrelation model; six motion regressors, artifact trials, and instructions/skipped trials included as nuisance regressors.

spans.text: To address age group differences in mean RT (see behavioral results in Supplementary Materials), trial durations were modeled as participant RTs ( Grinband et al., 2008 ). A 128 second high pass filter (appropriate because the design was estimated using events, not blocks) was used to remove low-frequency noise and an autoregressive model, AR(1), was used to estimate temporal autocorrelation.
These contrasts were then entered into a group model to estimate population effects.

Minimum cluster size thresholds were calculated using Monte Carlo simulations in AFNI. k-values and F-values are reported for peak voxels of each cluster. Additional subpeaks within larger clusters are included for descriptive purposes.TPJ, temporoparietal junction; PCC, posterior cingulate cortex; mPFC, medial prefrontal cortex; ACC, anterior cingulate cortex; PFC, prefrontal cortex; IFG, inferior frontal gyrus; OFC, orbital frontal cortex; Pre-SMA, pre-supplementary motor area; Prec, precuneus; DS, dorsal striatrum; RSC, retrosplenial cortex; VS, ventral striatum.
